reviews.comment: MY GOAT! His exams are the EXACT same as his old ones (same question types). The averages for his 3 exams this semester were all 90+. He's a funny guy with a dry sense of humor, I went to lecture and enjoyed it! He responds to emails quickly. He's also easy on the eyes. LOVE HIM WOULD RECOMMEND TO EVERYONE!
What a goat, maybe the goat of goats even.
hes a great proffestor, the coat

reviews.comment: The goat, his awesome. no complaints here.

The actual goat. This class is so easy, you have homework every week graded on completion. The exams are exactly like the practice exams and you geta a cheat sheet. He's a great teacher and a cool guy. To be honest you really don't have to go to class, most people stop going by the second half of the semester.  Take his class!!

Literally the goat. This class is extremely easy, homework every week graded by completion and he accepts latework. His exams are exactly the like practice exams and you get to bring a cheat sheet. He's a great teacher and a really good guy. You honestly don't even need to go to class, by the second half of the semester I showed up like twice.

reviews.comment: Great professor, his lectures are clear and easy to understand which he uploads to canvas, but most people decided to skip this semester since it was an 8am. He can be funny at times which makes the class enjoyable. Provided homework solutions and python code evening before hw is due so you can check ur work. Gives old exams as practice.

Dr. Kaihatu is one of the best professors I've had. His fluids class is very clear and easy to understand if you attend lecture. It does have weekly in-class quizzes, but they made sure I was keeping up with material which made studying easier. I really liked the fact that he hand graded all quizzes/exams and handed them back with written feedback.

One of the best CVEN profs that I've had so far. Had him for 302 and now 311. He has a dry sense of humor that's pretty funny, but he can tend to be monotoned at times when lecturing making it hard to pay attention. He posts his full lecture notes online after every class though which are pretty helpful on the HW. He's the best choice for 311 imo.

Great prof! Sometimes it seems like he is unhappy and he has a dry-sense of humor. Very friendly. Very very generous on partial credit. Gives out past tests for the two tests and they are very similar to the past tests. Labs can be difficult without a strong understanding of MATLAB and can sometimes take a very long time. Overall, would recommend!

Probably the best professor I've had in college so far. He doesn't upload his notes, so make sure you go to lecture or you won't know what you're doing. His lectures are straightforward with lots of example problems. Weekly quizzes over the homework, fair tests. he gives lots of partial credit, so just try your best and you'll do very well.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very very fair grader. Gives lots of partial credit. He looks unhappy all the time but he gives very good lectures and definitely isn't mean. Has a very funny sense of dry humor. If you can pick up on it, it makes his class that much more enjoyable. Definitely one of the best profs I've had.

Very Straightforward! Lectures were very in-depth which helped to understand the material. Homeworks and quizzes every week. Homework answers were uploaded the day before they were due. Quizzes were straightforward and based on the homework and concepts from the last week's lectures. Exams weren't tricky since he gives you his previous exams.

This professor is a straight shooter for all the good reasons. He understands that his students have very active lives outside the lecture room and shows this by posting homework solutions right before class. His exams reviews are a godsend and although sometimes he can be course it still shows that he just wants us to learn the material.
